title: "Testing reportfig"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
source("R/reportfig.R")
library(ggplot2)
library(lattice)
```

## Base R
```{r}
reportfig(plot(1:20, col="red", pch=19, main="Quarto Base R Test"), "quarto_base")
```

## ggplot2
```{r}
p <- ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width, color=Species)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  labs(title="Quarto ggplot2 Test")
reportfig(p, "quarto_ggplot")
```

## Lattice
```{r}
l <- bwplot(Sepal.Length ~ Species, data=iris, main="Quarto Lattice Test")
reportfig(l, "quarto_lattice")
```
